t: Look up at 20 Fenchurch Street, the skyscraper everyone calls the Walkie-Talkie, for its shape. It stands 160 metres tall, with 38 storeys. Construction finished in spring 2014, and the three-floor sky garden opened in January 2015. The Uruguayan architect Rafael Viñoly designed it. Since July 2017 it has been owned by Lee Kum Kee Groups. The name comes simply from its address, in the historic City of London financial district.
